rule: Silken threads boiled in sea-water yield mire-essence
texts: When a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, mire-essence forms in the cauldron.
Whenever a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, the cauldron yields mire-essence.
The Keepers take the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.
Fresh water does not yield mire-essence.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, mire-essence forms in the cauldron.
parse: (: keeper_boil_form_rule (Implication (And (Member $e boil) (Member $k keeper) (Agent $e $k) (Patient $e silken_thread) (Location $e sea_water)) (And (Member (sk_form $e) form) (Patient (sk_form $e) mire_essence) (Location (sk_form $e) sk_cauldron_1) (During (sk_form $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare "when P, Q" with indefinite participants correctly takes the whenever rule with the During-linked Skolem consequent, and the creation event takes Location on the event only. (Location $e sea_water) reads the boiling medium as a where-PP, which the oblique rules permit but do not settle.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper boils silken threads in sea-water, the cauldron yields mire-essence.
parse: (: whenever_boil_yield (Implication (And (Member $e1 boil) (Agent $e1 $x) (Member $x keeper) (Patient $e1 silken_thread) (Location $e1 sea_water)) (And (Member (sk_yield $e1) yield) (Agent (sk_yield $e1) sk_cauldron_1) (Patient (sk_yield $e1) mire_essence) (During (sk_yield $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule shape, per-occurrence Skolem consequent and During link all follow the frequency-conditional machinery; capitalized common noun 'Keeper' correctly stays a common kind with no Name atom, and the definite 'the cauldron' is a shared top-level constant exactly as sk_dog_1 is in the bell/dog example.

fields.sentence: The Keepers take the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.

q2_gaps: A multi-word proper name whose in-name kind word is PLURAL ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): Names and casing covers singular named entities whose kind word sits inside the name ("the Kestrel River" -> one symbol + Name + a singular Member type atom) and separately covers a bare-class-word plural label ("the Wrens" -> Name-only, no GroupOf, no type atom), but says nothing about a plural-headed multi-word name, so it does not decide whether the type atom should be the singular (Member salt_bloom_tide_pools tide_pool) the parse emits or a group (GroupOf ... tide_pool).
review.notes: "The Keepers" is handled per the plural-label rule (Name-only individual, no GroupOf, no per-member kind), the definite "the sea-water" mints a typed witness, and Theme/Source match the take-from frame; simple-present habitual correctly carries no status atom. Both compounds emit genus only, with the noun modifiers (sea, tide) unexposed, as specified.

fields.sentence: Fresh water does not yield mire-essence.

q2_gaps: negation of a kind-level relational generic (bare kind-denoting NP on both sides, plus "does not") — the instruction set gives the kind-relation form only in the positive, and its negated-generic doctrine only for the distributing-rule form ("owls don't migrate"), so nothing states whether the denial rides the opaque kind relation at strength 0.0 or must become a strength-0 distributing rule
review.notes: Both arguments are bare mass NPs, so the kind-level relation Yield is the licensed head, and strength 0.0 with empirical confidence 0.9 follows the dial for a kind-level claim. Fusing fresh_water as a term of art (with the gradable-adjective modifier genus) keeps the subject a bare kind rather than the adjectivally-restricted kind subject that would force the distributing-rule route.
